items.summary: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. items.summary: Real-time full-duplex speech models can listen while speaking, enabling natural interaction without rigid turn boundaries. items.summary: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. items.summary: Neural image watermarks can be forged by extracting watermark-bearing residuals from released images and transferring them to unrelated content.
